The Wolf Child

Little [From.GetFirstName] has been growing quickly. [From.GetSheHeCap] is alert and quick to learn, strong and healthy. [From.GetHerHisCap] voice is a little unusual, though, often dropping to a deep, playful growl. [From.GetSheHeCap] sniffs about in an odd way while looking for [From.GetHerHis] toys, and yes, [From.GetSheHe] is unusually hairy.\n\n[From.GetSheHeCap] has also bitten [From.GetHerHis] nurse several times. Apart from that, everything is perfectly normal.
A fine little cub!
This is strange and worrying...
Wolf's Legacy

Little [From.GetFirstName] is not like other children. [From.GetSheHeCap] growls when the others cry, runs faster and bites harder than any child [From.GetHerHis] age, and there is that sniffing thing [From.GetSheHe] does. You know the signs. [From.GetSheHeCap] has your blood, the blood of [Root.GetWolfSire].

Little [From.GetFirstName] is not like other children. [From.GetSheHeCap] growls when the others cry, runs faster and bites harder than any child [From.GetHerHis] age, and there is that sniffing thing [From.GetSheHe] does. If you did not know better, you would say the blood of [From.GetWolfSire] runs in [From.GetHerHis] veins, as it runs in [From.GetHerHis] other parent's.
[From.GetSheHeCap] will grow up strong!
Alas, I wish it were not so!

You are riding your lands with your best warriors when, in a shallow gorge of wind-bent trees, a thin wailing sound makes you rein in. A puppy? You spur your horse towards it and find a small cave. In the gloom lies a dead she-wolf, the marks of sickness plain on her. Beside her, on a bed of grass and leaves, lies a human child, wailing in a voice that sounds almost like an animal's in this strange place...
I shall raise this child as my own [New.GetSonDaughter].
I will have nothing to do with this!
The child is adopted with full rights of inheritance.

One day, playing outside by yourself, you notice that no one is watching you. All the grown-ups are busy. The perfect moment to explore! You sneak away towards the wilds, where you are never allowed to go alone...\n\nA few hours later you are lost, hopelessly lost. You sit down on a rock and start to cry, and then you hear something behind you. A big grey wolf is looking at you. She does not seem angry at all, and soon you understand that she wants to help you home. You run together until she will go no closer to the houses, and you wave goodbye and run home to tell everyone.
What an exciting day!

[From.GetFirstName] has been lost in the wilds all day. [From.GetSheHeCap] vanished this morning, and the searchers found nothing.\n\nJust as your worry turns to dread, a happy cry rings out. [From.GetFirstName] comes skipping home with a wide smile and shouts: '[Root.GetFatherMotherCap]! I ran so far, and then I met a nice wolf, and she was so friendly, and she brought me home! It was wonderful!'
What a strange tale...
I should start keeping [From.GetHerHim] locked up.
[Root.GetSonDaughter] of the Wolf?

For some time now you have felt the court talking about you. Conversations stop when you enter a room, voices drop behind your back, eyes follow you down the hall. You have worked out that you are a thing of curiosity, fear or envy, or all three.\n\nThe word you hear most often is... wolf. Only yesterday someone repeated the rumour you have heard many times: that you were born of a wolf mother, one of [Root.GetWolfSire]...
Yes, I am a wolf! Raawr!
I will teach them not to insult my mother!
They will never leave me alone!
These people do not deserve my attention.
[From.GetSonDaughter] of the Wolf?

For some time now the court has been gossiping about your [From.GetSonDaughter] [From.GetFirstName]. Conversations stop when you enter, voices drop, eyes follow [From.GetHerHim] down the hall.\n\nThe word you hear most often is... wolf. The gossips say [From.GetFirstName]'s true mother was a wolf, one of [From.GetWolfSire]...
I am glad they call my [From.GetSonDaughter] a wolf!
I must put a stop to this talk.
Wolf's Blood
The years pass, but some things do not change. You know that the blood of [Root.GetWolfSire] runs in your veins. It makes you strong, though sometimes it makes you wonder who you really are...
My future is still to be forged.
Your [From.GetSonDaughter] [From.GetFirstName] has come of age. The strangeness, [From.GetHerHis] wolfish nature, has not faded. If anything it has grown stronger.
I hope it proves a blessing and not a curse.
Wolves

On the hunt you keep glimpsing a pack of wolves, always at the edge of sight, and only when you are alone or no one else is looking. It quickens your blood and draws out every hunting instinct you have.
The hunt! I feel so alive!
Deep in the Night

For several nights now you have not slept well. It begins at midnight: wolves howling outside. You toss and turn, and the howling does not stop until late morning. And when silence falls, you find yourself missing the voices on the wind. You feel restless...
What is this?
Call of the Wolves

It never stops. Night after night the wolves howl outside. No one sleeps well, but you suffer worst of all: not only does the howling keep you awake, but when it stops you cannot stop waiting for it to come back...
I will go out and meet these wolves, alone.
I will go out, with guards.
I will wait. Surely this madness will end soon.
Hesitation
You go out into the night towards the hill where the wolves have gathered. As you and your guards draw near, the wolves pull back, uneasy.
Guards, leave me to meet these beasts alone.
This is pointless. Back inside.
Something Is Missing

The wolves have finally stopped howling, and for two weeks the nights have been silent. The whole court says it sleeps better. Everyone except you. There is a hollow in your soul. You dream of running with the pack, and wake each morning empty.
Who am I?
The Wolfpack

You walk towards the wolves alone, and this time they stand and wait, perfectly still. A dozen of them. One by one they come to you, sniffing, nudging you with their noses, growling softly. A feeling of belonging wells up in you and your whole body quickens. Then the pack moves off, and you follow, jogging, then running, at full speed into the wild...
Raaaawr!
The Wolves Hunt

You have been running with the wolves for a long while. Keeping their pace drives you to the edge of your strength, yet you have never felt so alive. You rest by cold streams and run again.\n\nThen hunger comes, and the pack hunts. They corner a great stag with perfect cunning and bring it down. Time to feast!
Rip, tear, devour!
Raw meat? Very well, only because I am so hungry...
A Farewell

You have lost count of the days. The pack treats you as one of its own, and the blood of the wolf has never sung so loud in you. Yet you have a home, lands to rule and kin who covet your seat. Reluctantly, you turn for home.
We will meet again!
The Homecoming

You come home after days in the wild with the pack. The court falls silent at the sight of you: clothes torn and caked with earth, leaves and blood, hair wild, face scratched by branches and by the loving attentions of your packmates. Most unsettling of all is the wide, wolfish grin on your face.\n\nYour servants hurry to meet you, trying hard to hide their fear. Everyone wants to know where you have been.

You come home after days in the wild with the pack. The court falls silent at the sight of you: clothes torn and caked with earth, leaves and blood, hair wild, face scratched by branches and by the loving attentions of your packmates. Most unsettling of all is the wide, wolfish grin on your face.\n\n[wolf_worried_homecoming.GetFirstName] rushes out to meet you, fussing over you and asking where you have been.
That is my own business.
Everything will be different now.
I was thinking of you all the time.
The Werewolf

For nights you have slept badly, with a strange pull on your mind. By day you are tired yet tense, waiting for something.\n\nTonight you wake and see Morrslieb rise, green and swollen beside her pale sister, and at last you understand. The Chaos moon is speaking to you. It is time to rise, time to become the wolf, time to run free, time to give your mind to the moon-madness...
Aoooouuuuuuuu!!!
Full Moon
Morrslieb has been waxing these past nights, and your restlessness waxes with it. You can feel it coming. It is time again to embrace the moon-madness...
What will the night bring?
You run through the night until you reach the highest hill in sight, and there you howl at Morrslieb for hours, exulting in her sickly light and in your madness.

You run through the night, farther and farther, the moon-madness driving you on. You leap ditches, climb hills and swim cold rivers, until you drop exhausted on the soft ground. Just to rest a little...
You run through the night, seeking prey. You find it, and you pounce: tearing, slashing, gouging, howling like the wolf you are. In the end the panicked lowing stops...
You run through the night, seeking prey. You find it, and you pounce: tearing, slashing, gouging, howling like the wolf you are. In the end the panicked squealing stops...
You run through the night, seeking prey. You find it, and you pounce: tearing, slashing, gouging, howling like the wolf you are. In the end the panicked yelping stops...
You run through the night, seeking prey. You find it on a lonely farm track, and you pounce: tearing, slashing, gouging, howling like the wolf you are. In the end the screaming stops...

You run through the night, seeking prey. You find it where you least expect, a familiar face walking alone in the dark, and you pounce: tearing, slashing, gouging, howling like the wolf you are. In the end the screaming stops...
Aoooouuuuuuuu!!!
So good, but so tiring...
Blood!
The Morning After
You wake feeling as if you had not slept at all. Your muscles ache and your throat is raw. When you try to speak, only a croak comes out. How could that be? You do not remember.
You wake feeling as if you had not slept at all. You remember nightmares, dimly. You are cold, and soaked through. What happened in the night? You do not remember at all.

You wake feeling as if you had not slept at all. You remember nightmares, dimly. Something wet and sticky covers your chest, and when you look down you see blood. It is not yours, and you do not remember how it got there. Yet something about it stirs a strange thrill in you...
Strange.

The blood of [Root.GetWolfSire] runs in you, and you feel it as you walk among the people of your court: you are not like them, you are above them. And the air is thick with the smell of meat, all around you. It could all be yours for the taking, if you are careful...
The wolf is hungry!
I... must... resist... it...

Mannslieb rides high in the night sky, pouring her pale light over the land. You look up and feel a strange longing. Your wolf's blood runs quicker, the moon beckons, and you raise your voice to her...
Aoooouuuuuuuu!!!

At dinner you drop a piece of meat, and a little dog darts in and snatches it. Before you can think, you are on your feet with your sword drawn, and the dog is skewered. [wolf_hunting_instinct_at_court_courtier.GetTitledName] stares in horror. You have just killed [wolf_hunting_instinct_at_court_courtier.GetHerHis] favourite dog.
No one touches my meat.

In the training yard and around the war table, moves and stratagems come to you that occur to no one else. Your captains are struck by your instinct for encirclement, feints and stealth, the way a pack takes its prey.
The wolves always catch their prey.
You run and wrestle every day to keep fit. It is a hunger for the hunt that drives you, and as you train you see the loping stride of wolves behind your eyes.
I feel strong!
You have always applied your mind well to any problem. Now you find that true strength comes when the cunning of the wolf is joined to the reason of a [Root.GetManWoman].
Few have it.

Lately a wolfish hunger stirs when you look at certain members of your court. You were taught to master your desires like everyone else, but the animal in you presses harder every day. Soon you will not be able to hold it back, and perhaps you do not want to.
Growl.
It is like an animal inside me!
I smell new smells...
The lone wolf does not survive. Only the pack that hunts as one will prosper. You know this in your bones, and you feel a deep need to draw everyone in and make your court a pack.
I almost licked someone today.
I have a new sense of... belonging.
The prey starts and flees at the slightest sound. The prey is afraid. The wolf goes forth without fear, knowing [Root.GetSheHe] will be the one who eats and not the one who is eaten.
I am the wolf.
I see it now.
The strong survive and the weak perish. That is the law of the wild, and in the wild the wolf is strongest.
The law must be respected.
I did not see it before.
A rage takes you sometimes, sudden and red. They say your forebears ran with [Root.GetWolfSire], and maybe they are right.
Let the wolf rage.
I cannot stop it!

Now and then, looking into a mirror, you see a wolf looking back. The change is slow but it does not stop: the jaw longer, the brow heavier, the hair coarser. You cannot decide whether you like it, but the court has started to look at you oddly.
There is nothing I can do about it.
And they used to think me fair...
When you sit down to reason out a problem, your mind bends back on itself. Your learning seems to slip away as instinct takes over, seeking simpler and more direct answers.
Maybe instinct is better than learning.

Mannslieb rides high, and you look up into her pale face and bask in her love. Your wolf's blood races as She beckons. Slowly you raise your voice to Her, and you howl as you will howl until the world ends. It fills you with joy, and you know that She and you are one!
